properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 (SHA family, including SHA-1 and SHA-256) declared in docs/package-lock.json for the documentation site toolchain. Presence-only record — no call site in the Go node, whose own chain hashing is SHA-256 via tmhash (object ALG-695a1eb5). SHA-1 is the weakest family member; hashes see only Grover's square-root, not Shor.

properties.name: pqs:context

Quantum-unsafe under Shor; migrate with the Ed25519 fleet to ML-DSA-65. Changeable here. Sampled 25/65 sites (codec, implementation, own tests) — all real.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 is the authenticator half of the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD that encrypts every P2P SecretConnection frame (MakeSecretConnection → Write/Read), and of the vendored XChaCha20-Poly1305 in crypto/xchacha20poly1305 (also exercised by p2p/conn/evil_secret_connection_test.go). Poly1305 is a one-time Wegman-Carter MAC, information-theoretically secure — not Shor-relevant; kept as the transport's MAC primitive record. Changeable here.

properties.value: bcrypt at cost 12 (above OWASP's 10 minimum), used only in crypto/xsalsa20symmetric/symmetric_test.go to stretch a passphrase into the 32-byte secretbox key for Encrypt/DecryptSymmetric tests; the shipped symmetric.go only documents "Sha256(Bcrypt(passphrase))" in comments and takes the key as a parameter. Password hashing — Grover square-root only, not Shor-relevant. No production caller of bcrypt in the repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Good-practice posture record: crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare in the private-key Equals methods of the vendored key types — ed25519.go:89, secp256k1.go:56 and sr25519/privkey.go:67. Constant-time private-key equality; a positive control, not a weakness. The sr25519 site is also the only place the deterministic pass touched crypto/sr25519 — the sr25519 signature scheme itself is reported as a separate finding.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-declaration aspect of X25519: tweetnacl@0.14.5 in the docs website npm tree exposes X25519 (nacl.box/scalarMult) in JavaScript — docs toolchain only, not reachable from the Go node; the go.mod side is the golang.org/x/crypto/curve25519 sub-package whose live call (p2p/conn/secret_connection.go:371) and PQ urgency are tracked under ALG-1138d04b.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 in docs/package-lock.json ships Ed25519 signing (nacl.sign) inside the documentation website toolchain — docs-side dependency record only; the node's own first-party Ed25519 implementation is object ALG-5e08bdf5. Quantum-unsafe under Shor like all Ed25519, but nothing in the node's security boundary uses this copy.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is the chain's core hash: tmhash (block/tx/app/merkle hashes, RFC6962-style tree) as the default crypto.Hash, secp256k1 signing digest, statesync chunk hashing, Tx.Hash, and the HKDF-SHA256 extraction inside the P2P SecretConnection handshake. Grover gives only a square-root speedup — not harvest-now-decrypt-later urgent; recorded as the canonical chain-hash primitive. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HKDF-SHA256 (RFC 5869) expands the X25519 DH secret into the two 32-byte directional ChaCha20-Poly1305 keys plus the 32-byte challenge for the P2P SecretConnection (secret_connection.go:341-352): hkdf.New(sha256.New, dhSecret, nil salt, info=TENDERMINT_SECRET_CONNECTION_KEY_AND_CHALLENGE_GEN), 96 bytes read out; direction assignment by lexicographic ephemeral-key order. The KDF itself is quantum-neutral — its PQ relevance rides entirely on the X25519 input that feeds it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 (x/crypto) is the AEAD sealing every P2P SecretConnection frame — chacha20poly1305.New(sendSecret/recvSecret) after HKDF-SHA256 derivation from the X25519 handshake, incrementing per-direction nonces. The vendored XChaCha20-Poly1305 in crypto/xchacha20poly1305 backs the P2P evil-twin tests. Symmetric AEAD: Grover square-root only, not quantum-urgent; the X25519 KEX that keys it is the PQ-relevant dependency. Changeable here.
